description: A viewer's own rearrangement of a scene, stored in the viewer's repo. Ranked app < author < viewer: the scene is the author layer, this record the viewer layer, a field it omits falls through to the layer below.

main.description: Record key is the rkey of the scene it overrides (a sidecar, so a viewer's override for a scene is a known-URI lookup). The scene field is authoritative; a reader ignores the record when the rkey of scene differs from the record key or scene is not the scene being rendered.

nodeOverride.description: Per-node patch, matched to the scene's node by id. A field that is absent is inherited.

id.description: Id of the node in the scene. An id the scene does not have is ignored.

hidden.description: The viewer has hidden this node.
